items.summary:
## Order

This is milestone 3 of 4 for growing the library. The milestones are worked one at a time, in this order.

1. Mirror Hermes Agent 2.0 (#3)
2. Review the mirrored chapters and run the evals (#4)
3. Add 12-factor-agents as a second collection (this issue)
4. Seek license evidence for the 17 reference-only books (#6)

This one goes third because it changes the license policy and adds a source reader. The eval command from milestone 2 can then check that the two mirrored books still pass.
